title: With Maxx Crosby trade done, the Ravens' next goal should be to extend Lamar Jackson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With Maxx Crosby trade done, the Ravens' next goal should be to extend Lamar Jackson
sources.description: Now that the Ravens have worked out a tentative deal to bring edge rusher extraordinaire Maxx Crosby to Baltimore, the next order of business is clear.
